reviewNotes: Twenty-five character-specific requests, rewards, quest-log fragments, and ore-gathering strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, newline and dialogue markers, leading and trailing spaces, dynamic item grammar, plural repair, addresses, signatures, character voice, punctuation, and natural concatenation; both found no remaining objective issue.
